WRIT IN THE NATURE OF MANDAMUS, DIRECTING RESPONDENTS TO PASS AN ORDER TO STOP THE WATER SUPPLY TO M/S ANHEUSER BUSCH INBEV INDIA LTD., (SPR DISTILLERIES PVT. LIMITED)
THE LIQUOR MANUFACTURING COMPANY BY CONSIDERING THE REPRESENTATION DATED 25/10/2025, VIDE ANNEXURE- X2 AND ETC.

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR PRELIMINARY HEARING, THIS DAY, ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. VIBHU BAKHRU, CHIEF JUSTICE  and  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE C.M. POONACHA  ORAL ORDER (PER: HON'BLE MR. VIBHU BAKHRU, CHIEF JUSTICE)
1.
Issue notice.
2. Learned AGA accepts notice for respondent Nos.1 to 16, 18 to 24 and 26 to 29.
NC: 2025:KHC:51920-DB HC-KAR 3.

Sri A. Mahesh Chowdhary, learned counsel is requested to take notice for respondent Nos.17 and 25.
4.
Considering the order proposed to be passed, it is not considered necessary to issue notice to other respondents.
5. The petitioner has filed the present petition making several allegations against respondent Nos.37 to 39 [Anheuser Busch InBev India Ltd].
It is the petitioner's case that the said company is carrying on its activities in violation of several laws.

It is stated that the said company is a engaged in manufacturing liquor and has its manufacturing unit located in Maliyur Village, Bannur Hobli, T.
Narasipura Taluk, Mysore District, Karnataka.
It is alleged that the said unit is generating pollution beyond the specified limits.
In particular, it is stated that the said company is using natural water sources for carrying on its manufacturing activities which according to the petitioner is impermissible.

It is stated that respondent-company apart from using the four bore wells which were located inside the factory premises have also drilled five additional bore wells and have altered the natural water level in the locality.
Additionally, the learned counsel for the petitioner also submits that the said company is resourcing water from other entities permitted to sell drinking water.
It is stated that the factory unit is not using the effluent treatment plant and is damaging the environment.
